status: Working baseline, 2026-09-26; preserve character identities. These are authoring references, not runtime overrides.
reusePolicy: Extensible colour references, not an exhaustive palette or universal count limit. Reuse suitable family neutrals and accents; introduce colours where identity, material or readability benefits. Keep one-off values asset-local, add shared tokens where reuse is useful, and preserve accepted colours outside an authorized colour refinement.

active_cyan.use: Small Copilot display accents; Developer reference, not a faction identifier

campus_ground.use: Approved home-campus dusk surface; not a global gameplay ground mandate

leaf.use: Established teal foliage; biome variations retained

warm_paper.use: Coding Task paper reference; clothing, skin and white armour retain their own palettes

problem_red.use: Bug warning accent reference; not a blanket enemy recolour

problem_bug.reason: 2026-09-27: remove uniform white self-emission; preserve cobalt/red palette, roughness 0.72 and presentation-owned lifecycle effects.

exceptions: Security navy casing, blue armour and white trim are identity colours.
Developer orange, Linter lime, Bug cobalt/red and Coding Task cream/blue/purple remain distinct.
Lag Spike cyan and Spaghetti lime/orange overlap friendly colours intentionally; silhouette, motion and UI must carry allegiance.
Human skin, hair, clothing, brand colours, imported atlases, spatial textures and separate emission maps are not normalized automatically.
Shared role names such as shell, ink or chalk are not global semantic IDs; select each mapping explicitly.
